ask.speaker: ilatea
ask.text: Small things matter. What do you need?

next-quest.speaker: ilatea
next-quest.text: The quest log, bottom left, names the next small step. Or ask the animal beside any door: they know what its site lacks.

airfield.speaker: ilatea
airfield.text: A pad with a sign: step on it to travel to the next region. Its sign says where it goes. One of them leads to the practice island.
